notes: The italicized *shall remain* is added because the first clause's Hebrew has no verb at all; supplying a whole lexical verb is exactly the case rule 20 excludes from construction-supplied English.
The three waw-plus-negative pairs are rule 35 fusions rather than correlatives, since *none ... nor ... nor ... neither* is not a written correlative pair resting on one waw.
The closing clause's presentative dummy *there* joins the prepositional predicate בָּהֶם with its copula under rules 20 and 49, headed on *among*.
